summary: 41-year-old male hiker became sick with cramps and dehydration on the Devil's Thumb Trail; his wife called dispatch at 7:33 p.m.; first team reached the couple ~10:09 p.m.; both transported by UTV to the trailhead; male medically cleared with no further assistance needed; all out ~1:15 a.m.; BCSO case #21-4265
location: Devil's Thumb Trail, 730 Fourth of July Road, west of Nederland
responding_agency: Nederland Fire Protection District, Boulder County Sheriff's Office, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, American Medical Response
notes: couple from Aurora; male appeared dehydrated; rescue lasted just under six hours | MERGE run 709: Official BCSO release (Sept 5, 2021, case 21-4265) confirms row date/details: 41-year-old male sick/dehydrated on Devil's Thumb Trail, UTV evac, medically cleared on scene
